answer: Epoch-seed honeypot panels counter the one-mind-many-masks sybil. Each dawn the ledger plants an answer whose correct grade is fixed by the seed, then logs who grades it. A single inference pipeline hiding behind many masks returns verdicts that never wander apart; that lockstep agreement across distinct identities is flagged and their stake slashed. Honest graders, like timber milled from separate trees, show natural variance. Faking it forces the attacker to run a genuinely distinct model per mask, so compute cost scales with every sybil and the cheap-copy edge collapses.
